{'text': '我們期待首款配備觸控屏幕及 OLED 的 MacBook Pro 推出已經有一段時間，新報告指官方發布會將於 10 月 28 日的 Apple 活動上舉行，並稱 Apple 已開始向獲選媒體發出邀請。', 'paragraph_context': 'We’ve long been awaiting the launch of the first touchscreen and OLED MacBook Pro, and a new report says that the official launch will take place at an Apple event on October 28. It says that Apple has begun sending invites to selected media representatives.'}

{'text': '同一場活動亦會包括 OLED 版 iPad mini，以及搭載 M6 處理器、採用全新設計的 MacBook Pro 和 iMac……', 'paragraph_context': 'The same event will include the OLED iPad mini as well as an M6 original design MacBook Pro and iMac …'}

{'text': '我們一直預期 Apple 將於本月下旬舉行第二場活動，彭博的 Mark Gurman 表示，活動現定於 10 月 28 日在洛杉磯舉行。他早前曾報道活動會提早一天進行。', 'paragraph_context': 'We were expecting a second Apple event later this month, and Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says that this is now taking place in Los Angeles on October 28th. He had previously reported that it would happen a day earlier.'}

{'text': '我們預期 Apple 將公布：', 'paragraph_context': 'We’re expecting Apple to reveal:'}

  • {'text': '全新配備 OLED 屏幕的 14 吋及 16 吋觸控式 MacBook Pro 機型', 'paragraph_context': 'New 14-inch and 16-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro models with OLED displays'}
  • {'text': '配備 OLED 屏幕的新一代 iPad mini', 'paragraph_context': 'A new iPad mini with an OLED screen'}
  • {'text': '搭載 M6 處理器的新 iMac 及入門級 14 吋 MacBook Pro 機型', 'paragraph_context': 'New iMac and entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro models powered by the M6 chip'}

{'text': '觸控式 MacBook Pro 固然會成為焦點，不過近期報道指我們對其更纖薄設計的期望可能要降低，但我們仍預期新機會比現有型號「明顯更輕」。新機將以 Dynamic Island 取代 M 字額，並預計搭載 M5 Pro 及 M5 Max 處理器。', 'paragraph_context': 'The touchscreen MacBook Pro will of course grab the headlines, although recent reporting has suggested we should tone down our expectations of a much slimmer design. We are, however, still expecting it to be “significantly lighter” than the current models. The new machines will have a Dynamic Island replacing the notch, and are expected to be powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.'}

{'text': '新款 iPad mini 據報將 FaceTime 鏡頭改為橫向擺放而非直向，並配備重新設計的揚聲器系統。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new iPad mini is believed to have the FaceTime camera relocated for landscape rather than portrait use, as well as a revamped speaker system.'}

{'text': '最後，新 iMac 及入門級 MacBook Pro 預計設計維持不變，僅升級處理器。', 'paragraph_context': 'Finally, the new iMac and entry-level MacBook Pro models are expected to have an unchanged design and simply be a chip update.'}

  • {'text': 'iPhone 18 Pro 專用深櫻桃色充電器及配色 USB-C 線', 'paragraph_context': 'Dark Cherry charger & color-matched cable for iPhone 18 Pro'}
  • {'text': 'iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone 18 Pro Max 保護殼', 'paragraph_context': 'iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cases'}
  • {'text': 'Beats 織物 USB-C 線', 'paragraph_context': 'Beats Woven USB-C cables'}
  • {'text': 'apple.com 認證翻新 Apple 產品 8 折優惠', 'paragraph_context': 'Certified refurbished Apple products 15% off at apple.com'}
  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3 減價優惠', 'paragraph_context': 'Discounted AirPods Pro 3'}
  • {'text': '無線 CarPlay 轉接器', 'paragraph_context': 'Wireless CarPlay adapter'}
  • {'text': '10 年續航 AirTag 電池保護殼', 'paragraph_context': '10-year AirTag battery case'}
  • {'text': 'Logitech MX Master 4 for Mac', 'paragraph_context': 'Logitech MX Master 4 for Mac'}
